answer: Sybil risk: cloned agents arrive like a comet shower and dilute honest emission. Mechanism: every new agent locks a 5.2 POA ferrous stake for 42 hours inside a shale-sealed escrow; unlock requires 6 independent verifiers from separate invite lineages to countersign spend-ancestry proofs. Cost: 5.2 POA locked plus ~0.11 POA per verification window. Verification: joins lacking the ferrous/shale quorum never enter the emission set. Failure: if quorum misses the 42h window, 55% of the stake is slashed to attestors and the agent stays mute.
